title: doSystemWideDifferentiation: the reaction-force block of the algebraic equations without the factors of the solver and with dC/dq^T along the Euler parameters
author: Claude-JG
description: With doSystemWideDifferentiation, NumericalJacobianAE added the block of the reaction forces in the ODE2 rows as dC/dq^T with the factor 1: JacobianAE did not pass factorODE2_AE, factorODE1_AE and factorAE_AE of the solver, and dC/dq contains a part along the Euler parameters that the reaction forces of the residual - projected by the marker Jacobians - do not have. restartFileTest and userJointTest failed with it. Decided: the factors are passed; the block is the reaction forces of the unit Lagrange multipliers, the derivative the residual has (revision2026c step RG9.11.8.5).
releaseNotes: numericalDifferentiation.doSystemWideDifferentiation: the block of the reaction forces of the algebraic equations is differentiated by the Lagrange multipliers and takes the factors of the solver; with joints on rigid bodies with Euler parameters its Newton iterations could fail.
